verdicts.spec_says: The Phone field accommodates four characters.
verdicts.code_does: The display-file field XTEL is declared as 5A (five characters) and the database column PHONENO is CHAR(5); the field accommodates five characters, not four.

undocumented.title: Minimum salary band enforced at 30,000
undocumented.code_does: The GetError procedure rejects any salary value below 30,000, returning 'Salary below minimum band'.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This HR policy constraint (commented as 2015-03) is not described by any specification rule and cannot be audited or changed without awareness.

undocumented.title: PHONENO database constraint restricts value to numeric range 00000–99998
undocumented.code_does: A CHECK constraint on the EMPLOYEE table requires PHONENO to be between '00000' and '99998', effectively limiting it to five-digit numeric strings.
undocumented.why_it_matters: No specification rule describes numeric-only or upper-bound constraints on the phone field; this silently rejects otherwise-valid extensions.

undocumented.title: Employee ID auto-generated by incrementing current maximum by 100
undocumented.code_does: getNewEmpId selects the maximum existing EMPNO, adds 100, and zero-pads it to six characters as the new employee ID.
undocumented.why_it_matters: The ID generation strategy (non-sequential +100 step, no gap-fill) is undocumented and could produce collisions or unexpected IDs if records are deleted.

undocumented.title: Misleading error message when Job field is blank
undocumented.code_does: When the XJOB field is empty the code returns the message 'Phone number cannot be blank' instead of a job-related message.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This is a copy-paste defect that will mislead users; no specification rule acknowledges this behaviour.

undocumented.title: Phone field validated as integer at entry time
undocumented.code_does: GetError attempts %int(XTEL) and returns 'Phone must be a number' if conversion fails, enforcing numeric-only input beyond what the display-file field type implies.
undocumented.why_it_matters: No specification rule states that the Phone field must be numeric; this constraint is invisible to spec readers.
